scope: Eleventh additive botanical identity shard. Uses R4 only where the literal Adelaide source name is a reviewed synonym or historical nomenclature of a canonical authority identity.

grapegen06-mazuelo-2098-2026-09-07.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - European Grapevine Catalogue, Annex 1B
grapegen06-mazuelo-2098-2026-09-07.notes: GrapeGen lists Spanish Mazuela with Mazuelo as a registered synonym under CARIGNAN NOIR, VIVC 2098. The Adelaide spelling Mazuelo is therefore linked as R4 rather than treated as an exact VIVC prime-name assertion.

vitisgrinzane-prosecco-glera-9741-2026-0.title: Vitis Grinzane - Glera B.
vitisgrinzane-prosecco-glera-9741-2026-0.notes: Current Vitis Grinzane identifies Glera as VIVC 9741, trueness-to-type confirmed, and records a Prosecco accession. The Adelaide historical source name Prosecco is therefore a reviewed R4 identity link, not a new prime identity.
